sources.title: Nollvisionen – tillsammans räddar vi liv
sources.excerpt: På sikt ska ingen dödas eller allvarligt skadas inom vägtransportsystemet
sources.supports: No deaths or serious injuries in the road transport system; shared responsibility of road users and system designers

sources.title: Drowsy Driving
sources.version: Live page; publication date not displayed in retrieved passage
sources.locator: Tips to Drive Alert: How To Avoid Driving Drowsy item 1; Short-Term Interventions item 1
sources.excerpt: Getting adequate sleep on a daily basis is the only true way
sources.supports: Adequate sleep is fundamental; coffee/energy drinks can give temporary perceived alertness without preventing microsleep in serious sleep deprivation
sources.fallback_reason: Exact sleep-remedy and temporary-alertness distinction not located in inspected TS/TRV pages; general physiological advice applies in Sweden; US speeds and recommendations not imported.

sources.title: Microsleeps — Module 3, Negative Impacts on Sleep
sources.version: Last reviewed 31 March 2020; Module 3, page 3 of 28
sources.excerpt: involuntary episodes of sleep lasting a few seconds
sources.supports: Brief unintended sleep; general physiological definition, not an occupational driving rule
sources.fallback_reason: Exact definition not located in inspected TS/TRV material; proposed VTI lead did not yield a retrievable exact definition.

sources.publisher: Swedish Government; published by Sveriges riksdag
sources.title: Drograttfylleri och sjöfylleri — proposition 1998/99:43
sources.locator: Printed page 24, paragraph beginning De centralstimulerande medlen
sources.excerpt: kan framkalla påtagligt höjt självförtroende i förening med hyperaktivitet
sources.supports: Amphetamine/cocaine can increase confidence while concentration and clear thinking are impaired
sources.fallback_reason: TRV alcohol/drug overview and TS substance reports give general impairment background but not this exact confidence claim. Historical passage used only for physiological effects, never current legal rules or obsolete warning-label advice.

sources.title: Drugs and Human Performance Fact Sheets
sources.locator: Printed pages 62–64 (PDF pages 63–65), Methamphetamine, Effects / Performance Effects / Effects on Driving
sources.excerpt: reduced fatigue or drowsiness, increased alertness
sources.supports: Perceived fatigue can diminish while risk-taking and driving impairment remain; fatigue and sleepiness may follow as drug effects change
sources.fallback_reason: Exact masking claim not located in inspected TS/TRV sources. Historical pharmacology summary supports a qualified can statement about stimulant misuse, not every prescribed dose or every stimulant.

source_searches.finding: General drug and medicine impairment; exact combined stimulant-confidence/masked-fatigue statement not located.
9 January 2025 consequence assessment: stimulant judgement/aggression effects; no exact masked-fatigue/microsleep/sleep-remedy passage located.
No sufficient exact passages located through these searches; this does not claim the organisations have no such material.
